company.shortDescription: Wyzant is an online marketplace that helps students connect with qualified in-person and online tutors in over 250 different subjects.
company.description: WyzAnt is an online marketplace where students and parents can find qualified, local in-person and online tutors in more than 250 different subjects. Visitors can browse WyzAnt's network of 75,000+ available tutors at no cost and compare tutors' experience, qualifications, personality and teaching style, background checks and more to ensure they find the perfect fit.  With WyzAnt's 100% Good Fit Guarantee, students can start lessons knowing they will only be charged if they are 100% satisfied with the tutor they have chosen.  Tutors on WyzAnt are individually screened and required to pass proficiency exams in the subjects they wish to teach. Tutors offer personalized instruction to students and professionals of all ages in subjects ranging form academics and test preparation, to language and computer training, to music and art lessons, as well as sports and recreation lessons.

aiResearchSummary.text: Wyzant is focusing on developing a specialized search system and method for matching students to tutors. This involves a system where users submit queries to identify and rank tutors based on relevance to the search criteria. The technology aims to enhance the efficiency and accuracy of connecting students with suitable tutors, optimizing the matchmaking process in their online marketplace.
